svg.title: Taxonomy of all 12 Fullmag physical interactions: conservative energy vs direct spin torques
svg.desc: Complete taxonomy of Fullmag's 12 physical interactions grouped by mathematical role: local energy densities (Zeeman, Anisotropy, Magnetoelastic), differential operators with natural BCs (Exchange, DMI, Inter-region couplings), nonlocal magnetostatic and current-field operators (Demagnetization, Oersted field), stochastic thermal Brown field (Thermal noise), and direct non-conservative spin torques (Slonczewski/Zhang-Li STT, Prescribed SOT, Drift-diffusion spin torque).
svg.text: Taxonomy of Fullmag's 12 Physical Interactions: Effective Fields vs. Direct Torques
Grouping by variational structure, operator locality, natural boundary laws, and LLG entry channel (Heff vs τdirect)
Hth,in = σin ξin, ξ ∼ N(0, I3)
Heff(x, t) = ∑k ∈ Kfield Hk (plus optional Hoe, Hth)
Conservative energy terms enter ONLY through −(μ0Ms)-1 δEk/δm; never treated as direct torques.
Auxiliary PDEs (CurrentTransport, ElasticBody, AntennaFieldSolve) supply driving fields/strains explicitly.
τdirect = (TG + α m×TG) / (1 + α2) [applied exactly once; never converted to pseudo-H]
Every term preserves m · ∂tm = 0 on S2; planner enforces lane legality per interaction.
